column1: # 49GAION v1.2.0 no-removal list (hub), from the v1.2.0 baseline at main e4a960e.
# One entry per line: <file>\t<kind>\t<value>. Kinds: heading (heading text), id (section,
# rule or decision id; 'Heading N' = a heading numbered N), term (glossary or defined term;
# HOAC terms match on the token HOAC), concept (a regex that must match somewhere in the repo).
# Only presence is checked, never definition text.
